Noah (Design): dropped an alternative compact trace header that groups playback, time-range chips, and a small export affordance. mock: https://imgur.com/alt-compact Priya - Eng: looks promising. main constraints: keep touch targets >=44px on mobile, and avoid adding extra DOM nodes per tick (virtualize). Sam PM: support wants a quick-copy that pastes trace id + permalink + selection window in one go. can we make that the default copy action on desktop? Luis Support: yes please. most triage flows are paste-first then attach HAR. default copy = full id + permalink + time-range in ISO (one-line header). Noah (Design): proposal: correlation pill shows truncated id with a tiny copy icon. clicking copies one-line header by default. secondary chevron opens options: Copy short, Copy full, Copy full + permalink (default). mobile opens bottom sheet. a11y-bot: keyboard flow: Tab to pill -> Enter opens menu -> Arrow keys navigate -> Enter to copy. add a status region for success messages: `
Copied trace link
`. also ensure copy labels have aria-labels like "Copy full trace id and permalink". Priya - Eng: implementation note: client constructs the copied payload, no backend needed. for export menu, HAR is default; add a tiny chevron to pick JSON. include metadata (trace id, permalink, selection start/end) inside exported file. Noah (Design): UX question: should "Download snapshot (.har)" be the label or "Export trace (.har)"? I prefer "Download trace snapshot (.har)" for clarity. Sam PM: lean to "Export trace (.har)" to match other product areas, but I don't feel strongly. clarity > micro-wording. Luis Support: also add an inline "Copy stack" action on collapsed frames. tiny link-style button. default format = plain text + permalink header. have an option in menu for markdown. Priya - Eng: keyboard shortcuts proposed: K toggle playback, Left/Right tiny scrub, Shift+Left/Right big scrub, Home/End jump to boundaries. add small hint "K" in tooltip and list them in Settings. ensure K is disabled when typing in inputs. Noah (Design): accessibility: timestamp readout should use `aria-live="polite"` and be throttled to ~250ms while dragging. screenreader phrasing should be human-friendly like "12 seconds, 300 milliseconds". a11y-bot: confirm throttling and natural-language formatting. also respect prefers-reduced-motion for scrubber animation. Priya - Eng: will implement throttling and natural formatting. for long traces we'll map scrubber to index instead of rendering all ticks to keep UI snappy. Sam PM: final callouts: 1) default copy = full id + permalink + time-range; 2) correlation pill has inline copy + menu for variants; 3) export primary = HAR with JSON secondary; 4) inline "Copy stack" for collapsed frames; 5) keyboard shortcuts use K + arrows; 6) timestamp aria-live polite + 250ms throttle. okay to proceed? Luis Support: +1 Priya - Eng: +1 Noah (Design): I'll update mocks and add a11y notes, pairing sync at 4pm. deploy-bot: preview deployed to https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-preview/2001234567 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Noah (Design): closing thread, will post final frames after sync. :white_check_mark:
